description: This shell script sets up a test environment for a Git and SVN integration project, performing repository creation, modifications, cloning, fetching, and resetting operations related to git-svn.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: External command wrapper for Subversion operations used for SVN commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected in a test case.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or content for equality in a test case.
